title: The Parts menu, page title and browser tab read Part Library
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NAME-01) exists, made by creating an inventory part with that number at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts.
  2. Read the entries under PARTS in the left menu.
  3. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  4. Read the page title.
  5. Read the title on the browser tab.
  6. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row.
  8. Read the title on the browser tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Under PARTS the left menu reads "Inventory" and "Part Library"; there is no "Catalog" entry.
  • Step 4: The page title reads "Part Library".
  • Step 5: The browser tab title reads "Part Library".
  • Step 8: On the entry's detail page the browser tab title reads "Library Part".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R1, S12-R2, S12-R12, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), board 7.0 (Before: the Catalog page today), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy.
